D: A young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr form the first team of mutants during the Cuban Missile Crisis.
P: Serve the snacks when Charles tries his lines on a girl in the Oxford pub.
S: Charles trying his lines in an Oxford pub
A board of aged cheddar, sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney, apple wedges and thick slices of crusty bread with butter.
Erik's visit to the bar in Argentina
Beef mince with onion, cumin and olives folded into pastry rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with chimichurri.
the standoff off the coast of Cuba
A thick béchamel of butter, flour and milk cooked with chopped ham, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, crumbed and fried until golden.
M: Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club in Las Vegas
Rib eye seared hard and butter basted, rested 5 minutes, served with a cream and cracked peppercorn sauce and crispy roast potatoes.
training the young mutants at the Xavier mansion
Whole chicken roasted at 200C with lemon and thyme for 75 minutes, carved with a potato salad and buttered green beans for the team.
W: Dark and white chocolate fudge set in a tray, cut into squares and arranged like a chess board.
K: the spy style of the early sixties
Gin stirred with dry vermouth over ice, strained into chilled glasses with an olive.

s.note: Charles trying his lines in an Oxford pub
s.how: Lay out 250g aged cheddar, 150g sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney and a sliced green apple on a board. Add thick slices of crusty bread and a dish of butter.

s.note: the standoff off the coast of Cuba
s.how: Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g flour and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Add 200g chopped ham and chill overnight. Shape into logs, crumb in 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden.

m.note: Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club in Las Vegas
m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 rib eyes hard, baste with 40g butter and rest 5 minutes. Crush 1 tbsp peppercorns into the pan, add 250ml cream and reduce. Pour over.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with half a tin of condensed milk and 20g butter and set in a lined tray. Repeat with 200g white chocolate and the rest of the milk in another tray. Cut into squares and arrange like a chess board.

d.note: the spy style of the early sixties
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a chilled glass and add a green olive. Makes four.
